source.title: C1 GATE — Backend Cart-to-Cash API + Database End-to-End Acceptance
source.body:
## RED TEAM WORKFLOW AUDIT — 15 OCT 2026

[Operational risk register](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/document/shinacare-red-team-cart-to-cash-operational-risk-register-15-oct-2026-a0d9a1a34b9e>) records 20 practical failure hypotheses with owner issue mappings, attack simulations and evidence classes. Main extra gap: supplier pickup custody ([GLO-243](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-243>)), classified **P1 investigation**, not automatically new C1 blocker; quality/expiry condition checks and barcode drift ([GLO-242](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-242>)) deserve explicit negative receiving/preparation scenarios. Test same persistent identities from Order→Supplier PO→Pickup (where required)→Hub→Driver→Collection/Settlement. **No findings claimed as proven exploits without current HEAD and DB+HTTP reproductions.** Keep frontend freeze and no invented physical verification.

---

## PRODUCT-IDENTITY RED TEAM GATE — 15 OCT

Manufacturer barcode scan is NOT sufficient to prove SKU/variant/size/pack/formula or saleable condition. [GLO-242](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-242>) adds reviewed barcode aliases/history, ambiguity rejection, reasoned operator fallback and test coverage across Supplier → Hub receiving → preparation. Real physical SKU proof and expiry/quality checks remain a separate human operational acceptance beyond automated tests.

---

## PAYMENT SCOPE CORRECTION — 15 OCT 2026

Owner confirmed ShinaCare must account for **COD, Visa/Mastercard and Vodafone Cash**, not assume COD is the only future checkout payment method. **C1 backend exit remains a REAL COD Cart-to-Cash E2E**, PLUS a tested lean payment-method-aware core/guardrails under [GLO-241](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-241>). This DOES NOT claim card or Vodafone Cash checkout is LIVE without an Egypt-compatible provider, merchant account, API credentials, signed callback verification and real sandbox evidence. Do not invent provider integrations or require keys for COD acceptance. For online methods keep unverified attempts PENDING, never synthesize paid/cash/settled, and avoid creating COD driver obligations. Separate provider settlement/payout from payment confirmation. Actual provider integration requires explicit owner approval and remains a later milestone.

---

## Goal (owner directive 15 Oct 2026)

BACKEND ONLY. Demonstrate one persisted Cart→quote→COD order→durable sourcing→consolidated supplier PO/confirmed allocations→Hub receipt→barcode-verified preparation+packing documents→driver run/custody/delivery→door-cash declaration→physical cash count→single correct settlement. Include availability/return/refund/support and supplier payables. No Storefront/Business Workspace design or implementation in this phase.

This is an **acceptance gate, not duplicate implementation**; work in linked existing canonical W issues and any verified missing backend task. Existing C0 cross-workspace UI acceptance (AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#118) is explicitly deferred, NOT Done.

## Required reproducible test evidence (same identifiers throughout)

- [ ] Real PostgreSQL test DB (\*\_test), migrations, scoped actor accounts for customer/guest/admin/supplier/hub/driver/cashier; no Neon/shared/production DB.
- [ ] Server-only cart quantity/revision, catalog sellability/prices, authoritative quote, price-change 409/requote, idempotent COD order, persisted confirmed address + geo pin, Cairo/Giza serviceability and role-safe pin access.
- [ ] Durable order.placed handoff/recovery, idempotent supply plan; supplier+SKU aggregated PO with N:1 quantity-aware PO-line-to-allocation mapping and deterministic partial/fallback; no late duplicate supply.
- [ ] Real Hub receiving quantity vs supplier Ready, correct source links, scan mismatch blocked, packed unique shipment identity and printable thermal receipt/slip data (physical printer testing deferred).
- [ ] Driver-only assigned manifests with secured coordinates/stop ordering, handoff scanning, dispatch atomic order+shipment effects, delivered/failed/retry/return consistency and safe replay.
- [ ] Expected COD vs declared door cash vs counted cashier cash vs settled; driver/courier/hub scope; zero duplicate/failed/undelivered settlement; explicit short/over variance; exact Decimal arithmetic.
- [ ] Supplier payable based on correct received/approved qty/cost snapshot, EGP, race-safe idempotency; cancellation/refund/manual COD refund evidence, support escalation and event/outbox truthfulness.
- [ ] Query/read APIs for role-scoped operational inboxes (no UI), RBAC/IDOR/PII negative HTTP cases, concurrency/transaction failure recovery.
- [ ] Single full-backend C2C automated integration suite, including critical negative cases; exact Git SHA, commands, passed/failed/skipped counts, DB target; no simulated success evidence.

## Acceptance

Backend PASS requires one replayable HTTP/API→DB run from cart to settled money, accurate cross-domain state, and documented negative/authorization/concurrency tests. Manual physical cash, printer, real supplier and all role UI acceptance are separate later operational gates; do NOT misrepresent them as backend-proven. Keep this issue In Progress until all backend bullets pass. No fixed date.

## Execution guardrails

Reuse implemented modules (do not rewrite Cart/Quote/Shipping/Scan/Settlement blindly); inspect HEAD, staged 26 deletions and private uploads before touching code; never broad-stage/reset; one coding agent at a time; scoped commits; no merge without owner approval. Claude may only update progress/evidence statuses and comments, not owner scope/dates/priorities.
